parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the request parameters and related business logic without performing the actual operation. If the dry run succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned.
false: performs the actual operation. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否仅预检本次请求。取值：

true：执行请求参数及相关业务校验，不执行实际操作。预检通过时返回错误码 DryRunOperation；预检失败时返回对应错误码。
false（默认值）：正常执行请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate execution. The token is generated by the caller, can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length, and is case-sensitive. You must use different client tokens for different business requests.
If a request with the same client token and the same parameters has been successfully executed, the original business result is returned within the validity period of the idempotence record, and the request is not executed again.
If the parameters corresponding to the same client token are inconsistent, the IdempotentParameterMismatch error code is returned.
If the request is being executed, the IdempotentRequestInProgress error code is returned.
If the execution result cannot be determined temporarily, the IdempotentResultPending error code is returned. Verify the execution result first to avoid duplicate submission with a different client token.
If this parameter is not specified or contains only whitespace characters, idempotence processing is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
用于保证请求幂等性，避免重复执行。由调用方生成，最长支持64个 ASCII 可打印字符，区分大小写。不同业务请求应使用不同的 ClientToken。

相同 ClientToken、相同参数的请求已执行成功时，在幂等记录有效期内返回原业务结果，不重复执行。
相同 ClientToken 对应的参数不一致时，返回 IdempotentParameterMismatch。
请求正在执行时，返回 IdempotentRequestInProgress。
执行结果暂时无法确认时，返回 IdempotentResultPending，请先核实执行结果，避免更换 ClientToken 重复提交。
不传或仅包含空白字符时，不启用幂等处理
parameters.name: client_token
